intact_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original mutated trash MONSTER sprite for a top-down 2D space shooter. Supplied scrap sprite is a PALETTE and PIXEL-ART STYLE reference only, not the monster shape. The creature is a compact round armored space parasite made from crumpled metal plates, cracked canister shells and tangled cables fused with dark violet organic tissue. One very readable angry luminous toxic-green eye in its center, a small jagged metal-toothed maw below it, two short crooked pipe pincers and 3 short cable tendrils around its compact body. It must read as a hostile living mutant, not another pile of scrap or a robot ship. Same dusty mauve/lavender gray metal, deep purple outlines/shadows and restrained warm copper highlights as the reference. Crisp deliberately low-resolution 32x32-style pixel art, chunky square pixels, limited palette, upper-left light. No antialiasing, gradients, soft bloom or photorealism. Centered front/top-down three-quarter view, entire creature visible, body occupies central 36% of square image, generous true alpha transparency all around. Output ONE isolated sprite with transparent RGBA background, no text, no floor, no stars, no checkerboard, no border, no logos. It will be exported with a 32x32-pixel creature centered in the existing 96x96 game frame.
destruction_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create an eight-frame DEATH animation sprite sheet for the exact mutated trash creature in the reference: one toxic-green eye, jagged maw, lavender-gray armor plates, dark purple tissue, pipe claws and three cable tendrils. Keep its exact design and crisp 32x32-style pixel art. This is a hostile barricade enemy, NOT collectible scrap. It collapses and implodes in place; NO outward-flying particles, no loose debris, no collectible orbs, no red glow circles. STRICT transparent RGBA sheet layout: FOUR columns by TWO rows, eight equal SQUARE cells, 2:1 canvas ideally 1536x768. No gutters, borders, labels, text, numbers or grid. Fixed view and centered origin in every cell. Creature occupies only central 36% of cell. Read left to right top row then bottom row. Frame1 exact intact creature. Frame2 eye flares yellow-green and armor cracks while all limbs stay attached. Frame3 limbs curl inward and armor buckles. Frame4 body crumples inward around eye, single connected silhouette. Frame5 smaller crushed dark violet silhouette, dim eye. Frame6 tiny compressed purple core, no detached fragments. Frame7 single very tiny dim purple speck at same center. Frame8 entirely transparent empty cell. Crisp square pixels, limited dusty mauve and violet palette, hard edges, no soft blur, no smoke clouds, no scenery or ground, no checkerboard. Export will be 8 horizontal 96x96 frames.
export: Nearest-neighbor binary-alpha export: intact body max 32x32 centered in 96x96; uniformly registered eight 96x96 death frames packed horizontally (768x96); first frame is exact intact sprite, final frame transparent. Uses ../debris/export-destruction.ps1 FitSingle/Export. No particle pickups or scrap reward.
